root_cause: The shared Composio account discovery path failed closed whenever more than one ACTIVE Instagram connection existed, even when exactly one connection represented the canonical bedrijfsgeheugen.nl account.
prevention: For Instagram only, ambiguous ACTIVE connections must be resolved by provider identity readback against the canonical bedrijfsgeheugen.nl username.
Exactly one canonical identity match is required; zero or multiple matches remain fail-closed.
Non-Instagram toolkits retain strict single-active-account semantics.
